description:
"Rip and tear into an enemy with your fangs, dealing |cffffff4085|r Physical Damage while applying Major Breach for |cffffff15|r seconds and the Sundered status effect on the initial rip and |cffffff4085|r Bleed Damage while tearing out, when it is done. 

The second hit deals up to |cffffff125|r% more damage to enemies with less than |cffffff25|r% Health and heals you for |cffffff3909|r, based off your Max Health.

Consumes a stack of Blood Hunger to increase the initial damage and healing done by |cffffff25|r%."
